data.name: Valid Passport
data.description: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay.
data.notes: Ensure you have at least 2 blank pages for visa stamps.

data.name: Academic Transcripts
data.description: Official transcripts from your previous academic institution.
data.notes: Must be officially translated if not in English, Dutch, French, or German.

data.name: English Proficiency Certificate
data.description: IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent English language certificate.
data.notes: Minimum IELTS 6.0 is required by most Dutch universities.

data.name: Motivation Letter
data.description: A letter explaining your reasons for choosing this program and university.
data.notes: Should be 400-600 words. Be specific about your goals.

data.name: Passport-Size Photographs
data.description: Recent passport-size photographs (35mm x 45mm, white background).
data.notes: Photos must be less than 6 months old.

data.name: Proof of Tuition Payment
data.description: Bank receipt or confirmation showing tuition payment to the university.
data.notes: Full tuition for the first year must typically be paid before the IND appointment.

data.name: Bank Statement — Block Money
data.description: Bank statement showing approximately EUR 11,400 as block money.
data.notes: Must be in your account for at least 28 days before the IND appointment.

data.name: University Admission Letter
data.description: Official admission offer from the Dutch university.
data.notes: Must be the final unconditional offer.

data.name: Travel Insurance
data.description: Comprehensive travel/health insurance covering your stay.
data.notes: Some embassies require proof of insurance for visa submission.

data.name: Proof of Accommodation
data.description: Confirmation of accommodation arrangements in the Netherlands.
data.notes: University dormitory confirmation or private rental agreement.
